capability.promise: Return the latest reference exchange rates for a base currency against every supported currency.
capability.description: Community-maintained Tracert listing of Exchange Rate API's keyless open endpoint. Given an ISO 4217 base currency, returns the current rate for ~160 currencies plus the upstream's own last/next update timestamps. Rates refresh about once every 24h, so a result is stable for the day: a receipt committing to the output can be reproduced by re-fetching and re-hashing. Example - GET /v6/latest/USD returns { "base_code": "USD", "rates": { "EUR": 0.8667, "GBP": 0.7417, ... } }. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Exchange Rate API.
excludes: Converting a specific amount (returns rates, not a computed total)
Real-time tick or interbank rates (data refreshes roughly once every 24h)

input.notes: Sent as a URL path segment on a GET, not a request body - append the base code to the endpoint (/v6/latest/USD).

errors.meaning: The requested base currency code is not supported by the provider.
The provider rate-limited the caller's IP (HTTP 429); cooldown is roughly 20 minutes.

interfaces.notes: GET {endpoint}/{base_code}, e.g. /v6/latest/USD. Keyless open endpoint; no account required.
Invoke via the hosted Tracert gateway (Streamable HTTP); this read executes live and returns a TRACE Receipt with a reproducible output commitment.

operations.rate_limits: Per-IP; roughly once/hour is safe. HTTP 429 with a ~20-minute cooldown when throttled.

input_retention.notes: The input is only a base-currency code (no user data). The provider publishes no request-retention statement to Tracert.

data_policy.notes: Unofficial free wrapper. The provider requires attribution ("Rates By Exchange Rate API") wherever the rates are displayed and prohibits bulk redistribution of the dataset; a Tracert receipt binds a hash of the output (a commitment), not the dataset itself. Values are marked "undisclosed" where the provider has not declared them - an honest unknown, never a safe default.

provenance.notes: Listing maintained by Tracert. Technical compatibility is not a commercial endorsement.

base_code.description: ISO 4217 base currency code. Returned rates are expressed per one unit of this currency. Appended to the endpoint path: /v6/latest/{base_code}.

time_last_update_utc.description: When the provider last refreshed rates (RFC 1123). Bind a receipt to this value for day-stable reproducibility.

time_next_update_utc.description: When the provider's next refresh is due.

rates.description: Map of ISO 4217 currency code to the rate per one unit of base_code.

capability.promise: Return dictionary definitions, part of speech, phonetics and pronunciation audio for an English word.
capability.description: Community-maintained Tracert listing of the Free Dictionary API. Given a single English word, returns one or more entries with parts of speech, definitions, synonyms and antonyms, phonetic spelling and links to pronunciation audio. Underlying data is derived from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA). Example - GET /api/v2/entries/en/serendipity returns [ { "word": "serendipity", "meanings": [ ... ] } ]. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Free Dictionary API project.
excludes: Guaranteed coverage (returns not_found when a word is absent)

input.notes: Sent as a URL path segment on a GET - append the word to the endpoint (/entries/en/serendipity).

errors.meaning: No definition was found for the requested word.
The caller was rate-limited by the provider.

interfaces.notes: GET {endpoint}/{word}, e.g. /entries/en/serendipity. No account or key required.
Invoke via the hosted Tracert gateway (Streamable HTTP); this read executes live and returns a TRACE Receipt.

operations.rate_limits: Community endpoint - no published limit; best-effort availability.

input_retention.notes: The input is a single dictionary word (no user data). This community project publishes no retention statement.

data_policy.notes: Unofficial free wrapper of a donation-funded community project with no SLA or uptime guarantee. Definition data is derived from Wiktionary and licensed CC BY-SA; retain attribution when redisplaying it. Fields are marked "undisclosed" where the project has not declared them.

provenance.notes: Listing maintained by Tracert. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the upstream project.

word.description: A single English word to define. Appended to the endpoint path: /entries/en/{word}.

outputSchema.title: Define word - output
outputSchema.description: One or more dictionary entries for the word.

audio.description: URL to a pronunciation audio clip (may be empty).

definitions.definition: A combination of events which have come together by chance to make a surprisingly good or wonderful outcome.

capability.promise: List an AI tool in the public PromptFrenzy AI Directory: verify a required dofollow backlink badge on the tool's own domain and, if it passes, open and auto-merge a permanent public directory entry.
capability.description: Submit a single AI tool for inclusion in the PromptFrenzy AI Directory, a badge-required public directory of AI tools built to be submitted to by developers and coding agents. The service verifies that the PromptFrenzy badge anchor is present and dofollow on the page you nominate, classifies the host (a domain you control = full listing; platform subdomains like *.vercel.app = early-stage; raw IPs, temporary tunnels and link shorteners are rejected), and if it passes uses the directory bot to open and auto-merge a public YAML entry in the Prompt-Frenzy/ai-directory GitHub repository. Verification typically completes in under 60 seconds. No human review queue, no fee. Listings are re-verified weekly and dropped if the badge disappears.
excludes: Tools on rejected hosts (raw IPs, temporary tunnels, link shorteners)
Any tool without a verifiable dofollow badge on a domain you control
Any guarantee of search ranking or traffic from the backlink
Editing or removing a listing you did not submit

errors.meaning: A required field is missing or malformed; the response body lists the offending fields.
The badge anchor was not found on badge_url, or it carries rel="nofollow"/"sponsored", or badge_url is not on the same domain as url. Add a static dofollow badge on your own domain and resubmit.
The url host is a raw IP, temporary tunnel, or link shortener and cannot be listed.
A tool with the derived slug already exists; supply a different slug.
Badge verified but the directory bot failed to open the PR; retry.

input_retention.notes: Submitted listing fields (name, url, description, category, pricing, badge_url and any optional context) are published permanently as a public record in the Prompt-Frenzy/ai-directory GitHub repository; that publication is the purpose of the service, and entries are removable on request. The nominated badge page is fetched only to verify the badge and is not stored.

inputSchema.title: promptfrenzy.list-ai-tool input
inputSchema.description: Payload for POST https://www.promptfrenzy.com/api/directory/submit — one AI tool to list in the PromptFrenzy AI Directory. Mirrors the live server contract.

url.description: Canonical homepage of the tool, on a durable domain you control. Raw IPs, temporary tunnels and link shorteners are rejected; platform subdomains (*.vercel.app etc.) list as early-stage.

description.description: One-sentence factual description. No superlatives or marketing copy.

badge_url.description: Page on the same domain as url where the PromptFrenzy dofollow badge anchor is present in static HTML. The verifier fetches this page; JS-rendered badges are not seen.

tags.description: Up to 5 lowercase-hyphen tags. Optional but encouraged.

pricing_detail.description: Specific pricing beyond the tier, e.g. 'Free tier watermarked; Pro $12/mo for 1,000 credits'. Optional but encouraged.

key_features.description: 2-6 short factual capability bullets. Optional but encouraged.

works_with.description: Tools, platforms or models this integrates with, e.g. ['chatgpt', 'figma']. Optional but encouraged.

platforms.description: Where the tool runs / how it is accessed. Optional but encouraged.

slug.description: Optional explicit slug; otherwise derived from name. Must be unique in the directory.

outputSchema.title: promptfrenzy.list-ai-tool output
outputSchema.description: HTTP 201 response from POST /api/directory/submit after the badge is verified and the directory PR is opened. Mirrors the live server contract.

status.description: Badge verified and directory entry opened.

slug.description: Slug the listing was created under.

pr_url.description: GitHub pull request that adds (and auto-merges) the listing.

branch.description: Branch the directory bot opened for the entry.

capability.promise: Generate a QR code image encoding a supplied piece of text or a URL.
capability.description: Community-maintained Tracert listing of the goQR.me QR Code API. Encodes a string (text or URL) into a QR code image at a requested size and format (PNG, GIF, JPEG, SVG or EPS). Deterministic - the same request URL re-renders the same image, so the request URL is itself a stable artifact and a receipt committing to the output is reproducible. Example - GET /v1/create-qr-code/?data=https://tracert.site&size=180x180 returns an image/png. Not affiliated with or endorsed by goQR.me.
excludes: Decoding or reading existing QR codes
Guaranteed hosting or permanence of the generated image

input.notes: Sent as URL query parameters on a GET (data, size, format), not a request body.

output.notes: The response body is the QR image. The create-qr-code request URL is itself a stable, re-fetchable artifact.

errors.meaning: The data was empty or too long, or the size parameter was malformed.
The QR Server API was unreachable.

interfaces.notes: GET with query params data (required), size (WxH, e.g. 200x200), format (png|gif|jpeg|svg|eps).
Invoke via the hosted Tracert gateway (Streamable HTTP); this transform executes live and returns a TRACE Receipt binding the image bytes' sha256.

operations.rate_limits: No hard limit; the provider asks to be notified above roughly 10,000 requests/day.

input_retention.notes: The data you submit is transmitted to goQR.me to render the image; the provider publishes no retention statement. Do not encode secrets you would not send to a third party.

data_policy.notes: Unofficial free wrapper. goQR.me documents the API as free for commercial and non-commercial use with no account or key. Fields are marked "undisclosed" where the provider has not declared them.

provenance.notes: Listing maintained by Tracert. Not affiliated with or endorsed by goQR.me.

data.description: The text or URL to encode.

outputSchema.title: Create QR code - output (image bytes)
outputSchema.description: The response body is the generated QR code image (PNG by default; GIF, JPEG, SVG or EPS per the requested format). The create-qr-code request URL re-renders the same image on each GET, so it is itself a stable, verifiable artifact.

capability.promise: Create a short tinyurl.com link that redirects to a supplied long URL.
capability.description: Community-maintained Tracert listing of TinyURL's keyless create endpoint. Given a long URL, returns a short tinyurl.com link that publicly redirects to it; an optional custom keyword may be requested. This is a WRITE that creates a durable public artifact (the short link). The same long URL always yields the same short link (TinyURL dedupes), so the write is idempotent. The submitted URL becomes publicly resolvable, so never include secrets, tokens or private query parameters. Example - GET /api-create.php?url=https://tracert.site returns https://tinyurl.com/28y67wky (text/plain). Not affiliated with or endorsed by TinyURL.
excludes: Guaranteed permanence of the short link

input.notes: Sent as URL query parameters on a GET (url, optional alias), not a request body.

output.notes: The response body is the short URL as plain text (or an error string on failure).

errors.meaning: The URL was missing or malformed, or a requested custom keyword was already taken.
The TinyURL API was unreachable or returned an error.

interfaces.notes: GET with query params url (required) and optional alias (custom keyword). Returns the short URL as text/plain. No account or key required.

operations.rate_limits: Keyless endpoint; heavy automated use may be throttled.

input_retention.notes: The submitted long URL is stored indefinitely as the redirect target for the life of the short link, and becomes publicly resolvable.

data_policy.notes: Unofficial free wrapper. This capability performs a PUBLIC WRITE - the short link and its target are publicly accessible. Never submit URLs that contain credentials or private parameters. training_use is marked "undisclosed" where the provider has not declared it.

provenance.notes: Listing maintained by Tracert. Not affiliated with or endorsed by TinyURL.

url.description: The long URL to shorten. WARNING: this becomes a publicly resolvable redirect - never include secrets, tokens or private query parameters.

alias.description: Optional custom keyword. The request fails if the keyword is already taken.

outputSchema.title: Shorten URL - output (short link)
outputSchema.description: The created short URL, returned as text/plain. The same long URL always yields the same short link (TinyURL dedupes identical URLs).
